title: Make the payment webhook safe to deliver twice
acceptanceCriteria: A delivery whose `v1` signature matches `"<t>.<raw body>"` is applied once and answered `200` — whatever whitespace the body has
A wrong signature, an edited body or a missing header gets `400`, and nothing is applied
A correctly signed delivery more than `toleranceSeconds` old gets `400`, and nothing is applied
A retry of an applied event — same `id`, new timestamp and signature — gets `200` without applying it again
If `apply` throws, the answer is `500` and the event is not recorded, so a later delivery applies it
